errors.description: The waistband carries a worked buttonhole but no button through it, so the closure reads as unfastened.
errors.expected: Waistband closure mark at the fly as drawn.
errors.correction: Render the waistband button seated in the buttonhole.

notes: Blueprint (6a4438c01dcf__3401.jpg) traces the waistband top edge in red then runs the red straight down the fly edge; the distinguishing feature versus the sibling is the absence of a fish-mouth notch. Magnified inspection of the candidate confirms a dead-vertical, unnotched fly fold with the topstitch parallel and correctly on the overlapping side. Red guide marks were correctly not reproduced as coloured cloth.
